decisions.reason: s0004 has 授普太尉; 太尉 is Grand Commandant, not grand mentor (太傅/太保). The proposed replacement corrects the office title.
The same Chinese 授普太尉 shows Grand Mentor is wrong in the literal field; Grand Commandant matches 太尉.
s0009 has 累遷太尉、朔州刺史; 太尉 is Grand Commandant, not grand mentor. The repair restores the correct office.
Literal likewise mistranslates 太尉 as Grand Mentor; Grand Commandant is the accurate title.
共圖悅 targets Houmochen Yue (悅), not Heba Yue (岳). After 率岳所部, bare English 'Yue' wrongly invites reading the plot as against Heba Yue; naming Houmochen Yue removes that error.
The literal has the same 共圖悅 referent; specifying Houmochen Yue correctly disambiguates 悅 from 岳.
s0096 names 尒朱天光; 天光 is Tianguang, not Tianzhong. The replacement corrects the personal name.
The literal likewise misreads 天光 as Tianzhong; Tianguang matches the Chinese name.
Antecedent 天光 continues Erzhu Tianguang from s0096; Tianzhong is a false reading of 天光.
Literal 天光 must likewise be Tianguang, matching the established name in the prior unit.
天光敗 again refers to Erzhu Tianguang; Tianguang corrects the misread given name.
The literal 天光敗 has the same referent; Tianguang is the accurate reading of 天光.
從尒朱天光平關右 names Erzhu Tianguang; Tianzhong misreads 天光.
Literal likewise has 尒朱天光; Erzhu Tianguang is the correct English personal name.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0007 shows English Erzhu Tianzhong came only from misreading 尒朱天光; the personal-name claim must read Erzhu Tianguang while keeping zh, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
Accepted r0009 restores the given name of 天光 as Tianguang; Tianzhong was created solely by the bad translation.
